description: This Java class implements a command strategy for creating a charge on a loan within the Fineract platform. It processes batch requests by extracting loan IDs from URLs and delegating the creation of charges to the LoanChargesApiResource, handling responses and errors accordingly.

classes.name: CreateChargeCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing CommandStrategy to handle creating a loan charge via batch API requests.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch request to create a loan charge, extracting parameters from the URL and invoking the LoanChargesApiResource, then prepares and returns a BatchResponse.
